about.source: Blizzard's client data tables, build 12.1.5.70783, as published by wago.tools; built by docs/reference/build_content.py on 2026-11-04
about.fields: per item: spell, trigger (INFERENCE from ItemEffect.TriggerType), spec (0 = any), cooldownMs, charges, auras: the aura-applying spells reached through EffectTriggerSpell (up to 3 steps) with target (INFERENCE from ImplicitTarget_0: self = a buff on you, enemy = a debuff, ally)
about.note: Many item effects are scripted on the server: the data then shows no aura, or a dummy one. Confirm in game with the Dev Assist cast recorder / aura log.
